fields: L6 Hong Kong / Mid-Autumn Festival (inline roller skates; Central → Victoria Harbour → The Peak). Same item fields as L3 v3.1 / L4 / L5. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = 月饼摊 Mooncake Stall questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh must equal choices; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12 where CJK=1, ASCII=0.5), peak_final = The Peak / 太平山顶 final (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational, no bare arithmetic). Per run: 3 timed stall in segment 1 + 4 fork in segment 2 + 2 timed stall and 1 Peak final in segment 3 = 10 (one stall pool, drawn as 5 then split 3+2; do not place all 5 timed questions in the first segment). Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Festival riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'), labelled Festival riddle: / 中秋谜：. Stems are deduped against all L1–L5 banks (all grades).

questions.subject: language
questions.q_en: At the Peak, Auntie quotes 但愿人长久，千里共婵娟 while they share a mooncake. The line is mainly about ____.
questions.q_zh: 在太平山，阿嫲一边分月饼一边念“但愿人长久，千里共婵娟”。这句主要是说____。
choices: counting how many trams are left
wishing people far apart well under the same moon
choices_zh: 祝不在一起的人平安，共看同一轮明月
questions.explain_en: The line is a Mid-Autumn wish about the shared moon.
questions.explain_zh: 这是中秋时关于共看明月的祝福。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: On the Peak, Flora sees a far lantern-bearer's arm move, then hears a call. The delay is because ____.
questions.q_zh: 在太平山，Flora 先看见远处提灯人的手臂动了，然后才听见叫声。有延迟，是因为____。
choices: skates store the sound in the wheels
light reaches her faster than sound
choices_zh: 轮滑把声音存在轮子里
questions.explain_en: Light travels much faster than sound.

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A cooler of mooncakes at the Peak lookout reads -6 °C. After it is opened it warms by 6 °C. What is the new temperature in °C?
questions.q_zh: 太平山观景台一箱月饼的冷藏箱显示 -6 °C，打开后升高了 6 °C，现在多少摄氏度？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: On a Hong Kong map, 1 cm stands for 250 m. The path from the harbour to the Peak is 10 cm on the map. How many metres is it really?
questions.q_zh: 香港地图上 1 厘米代表 250 米，从维港到太平山的路在图上长 10 厘米，实际是多少米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Last year 600 visitors watched the trams from the harbour. This year there are 15% more. How many visitors are there this year?
questions.q_zh: 去年有 600 位游客在维港看叮叮车，今年多了 15%，今年有多少人？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A harbour river-walk ticket costs a 6-yuan fee plus 12 yuan per person. Flora's group pays 30 yuan. How many people are in the group?
questions.q_zh: 维港江边步行要付 6 元手续费，每人再付 12 元。Flora 一行共付了 30 元，一共几个人？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A sketch of the Peak lookoutway is 4 cm wide and 6 cm tall. A similar banner copy is 12 cm wide. How tall is the banner in cm?
questions.q_zh: 太平山观景台的草图宽 4 厘米、高 6 厘米，放大成相似的横幅后宽 12 厘米，高是多少厘米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Over four evenings, Flora counts 7, 9, 12 and 8 boats passing the harbour. What is the mean number per evening?
questions.q_zh: 连续四个晚上，Flora 在维港数到 7、9、12、8 条船，平均每晚几条？
